name: XRF55
summary: Large multimodal dataset of 55 segmented indoor actions for cross-modal and cross-domain human activity recognition.

hardware.platform: WiFi transmitter and three receivers plus RF sensors

settings.scenario: Segmented indoor actions across people and scenes

standardization.notes: Preserve each complete 5-second, 200 Hz source clip as [1000,30,1,9]. The default activity view resamples only time to 100 Hz, splits the resulting 500 steps into 300-step windows, and pads only the final remainder. Keep all 30 subcarriers and all nine receiver-device/antenna streams as 1 Tx × 9 Rx.
